cards.title: Sprinter Limo Features
items: Spacious seating for up to 14 passengers

faqs.q: How many passengers can the Sprinter Limo accommodate?
faqs.a: + Our Mercedes Sprinter Limo comfortably seats up to 14 passengers, making it the perfect choice for medium-sized groups.

faqs.q: What features are included in the Sprinter Limo?
faqs.a: + The Sprinter Limo comes with premium leather seating, climate control, flat screen TV, premium sound system, ample luggage space, tinted privacy windows, and complimentary bottled water.

faqs.q: Do you offer airport transportation with the Sprinter Limo?
faqs.a: + Yes, we provide reliable airport transportation to and from all major airports including John Wayne (SNA), Long Beach (LGB), LAX, and Ontario (ONT).

faqs.q: How much does Sprinter Limo service cost?
faqs.a: + Pricing depends on the duration, distance, and specific requirements of your trip. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote tailored to your needs.

faqs.q: Is the Sprinter Limo suitable for corporate accounts?
faqs.a: + Absolutely. We offer corporate and executive transportation packages with professional chauffeurs, ensuring your team arrives comfortably and on time.

faqs.q: Can I book the Sprinter Limo for a wedding party?
faqs.a: + Yes, our Sprinter Limo is a popular choice for wedding parties. We offer special wedding packages with red carpet service and decorations.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I reserve the Sprinter Limo?
faqs.a: + We recommend booking 2-4 weeks in advance for special events. However, we also accommodate last-minute requests whenever possible.
